position_end: A draft instrument made by the minister in charge of broadcasting content under section 226(1) of the Information and Communications Act (Cap. 74:03) in consultation with the regulator, issued for public consultation on 2 April 2026 as one of seven draft instruments released together — among them Journalists Registration Guidelines, 2026 and licensing, registration and authorisation guidelines. milestone: Central Bank convened producers and users, 22 July 2026
position_start: No convened process on record
position_end: Producers and users convened by the Central Bank with the International Monetary Fund and the Bureau of Statistics, naming data gaps, inconsistency and inaccessibility as the constraints; no framework or workplan published (2026-07)

subject: data.statistics
name: Gambia Labour Force Survey series
milestone: Fifth round disseminated at Bakau with a first three-round trend volume, July 2026
position_start: Four rounds published, with no cross-round comparison volume (2025-08)
position_end: Fifth round published with the first systematic comparison across the 2023, 2025 and 2026 rounds, and a sixth round confirmed for later in 2026 (2026-07)
note: Both reports are donor-financed through the World Bank HISWACA project with ILO technical support; no domestic recurrent budget line for the series is established, and neither report's release date is published.

subject: data.open
name: Open budget transparency ranking
milestone: 2025 open budget survey results
position_start: the base carries no position at the start of the period
position_end: 36 out of 100 on transparency, 24 on public participation and 59 on oversight in the 2025 open budget survey, and third in sub-Saharan Africa on budget transparency
